scope: Complete fixed-seed small-domain scan. Completion and observed sampling diagnostics only; no general success probability, omitted-tail bound or wider-precision validation of every seed.
timing_scope: Application CPU covers spectral grid including geometry and ordered output; process CPU and driver elapsed times are retained separately.

source_provenance.qualification: Clean-checkout replay. Every export embeds the source revision. Source bundle, build command/log, frozen binary and original exports are archived; no provenance substitution is needed by the numerical validator.

selection: Every planned query: seeds 1 through 40 at 32 samples, then seeds 1 through 20 at 128 samples. No omitted or substituted seed.

prior_scan.comparison_scope: All table rows, columns and numerical metadata agree; source revision, date, command path and timing summaries differ. Costs and hashes in this record come exclusively from the clean replay. Original archive and prior compact record remain unchanged.
